test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 30 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b28dae0bb85b4e920289b33f1cbe5fbdf2bc7ef5e5b126a6d9639a5e632fb4a.png] 

The logic followed here is based on the alphabetical position pattern:

Option 1: BF – EI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba6432c878090ccc7f95f29d3a1e80658c7dd785c1ba9326bddb1813a2efb91e.png] 

Option 2: VZ – YC

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ee56d7a731278953de0041b5ee520047ab2cf38e104ec96747eb7ed49c77b6a.png] 

Option 3: ZD – BI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/601484964ace18f9b51c18efb7a21c2ef4479cd5ad17d9a69c56e6215b14d9cf.png] 

Option 4: IM−LP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e31e3dcb3f92c3f75e6432b6b8bad065ff026701474497b533abc65e51523346.png] 

Thus, ZD – BI does not follow the same rule.

Hence, the odd one out is **Option 3.**
